title: Layout and band geometry are built on hand-mirrored height heuristics instead of React Flow's measured dimensions
existing_state: All block heights used by the layout engine and branch bands are estimates that must manually mirror BaseBlock's CSS: estimateNodeHeight encodes header ~30px, SUMMARY_PAD 14, row heights 20/32, footer 24, and a 16-chars-per-line label-wrap budget (FlowCanvas/src/utils/nodeSize.ts:29-57, header comment :1-3 'height is an ESTIMATE'); comment space uses a separate 33-chars/17px heuristic (utils/layout/hierarchicalLayout.ts:60-72). Any styling change in BaseBlock silently desynchronizes five constants. This estimate-vs-DOM split has already produced shipped overlap defects: nodeSize.ts:49-50 documents 'the estimate undershoots and the next block overlaps', and the preset-switch leak fix comment describes blocks rendering expanded while the layout estimated them collapsed, producing overlap (stores/messageBridge.ts:164-168). Meanwhile the app is on @xyflow/react ^12.10.1 (FlowCanvas/package.json:23), where node.measured.width/height are populated after first render -- and most reflows (expand/collapse via debugSlice.ts, display-settings changes via settingsSlice.ts, comment add/remove, the sizing restore that fires after load-graph) run post-render, when real measurements exist. The nodeSize.ts:2 comment ('xyflow exposes no measured height at layout time') is only true for the very first import layout.
recommendation: Thread measured dimensions into reflows: in computeHierarchicalLayout (and computeBranchBands), prefer node.measured?.height when present and fall back to estimateNodeHeight only for unmeasured nodes (first import, freshly added blocks). Optionally add a one-frame measure-then-relayout pass after load-graph so even the initial layout self-corrects. This shrinks the heuristics to a cold-start fallback instead of the single source of geometry, eliminating the estimate-drift overlap class and the need to keep five constants in sync with BaseBlock CSS.
user_benefit: Blocks and bands stop overlapping at unusual text scales / long labels / future styling tweaks, and styling changes to blocks no longer require remembering to retune layout constants.

evidence.note: estimate constants that mirror BaseBlock CSS; comment admits undershoot causes overlap
